Midground on left has a few stepped tombs, on right broken masonry. Lower third is a flat dark foreground stone landing with deep nearly black shadow and calm negative space where four short centered menu text items will be placed later. The architecture fills most of the canvas, with organically irregular black framing on the edges. Quiet asymmetrical composition, not symmetrical cathedral. No forest, no characters, no words, no letters, no logo, no interface, no fancy golden door, no smooth illustration, no gradients or volumetric rendering. Very important: full composed landscape scene extending across the upper 75% of the screen, NOT a single object floating on black.
